FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Which platform should I sell on?

Shopify suits most merchants. WooCommerce fits content-heavy brands already on WordPress, and Magento suits large, complex catalogues. We recommend based on your catalogue and team.

Can you redesign my existing store?

Yes, and we start by looking at your analytics to find where orders are being lost before changing anything.

Will the design work on mobile?

It is designed for mobile first. Most store traffic arrives on a phone, so that is where the design has to be strongest.

Do you migrate products from my old store?

Yes. Products, customers, orders and URL redirects are all part of a properly handled migration.

Is Your Current Design Holding Back Sales?

Let us look at your store and show you where shoppers are dropping out.
